candidates.change_summary: Changed `new EmergencyOracle(msg.sender, description)` to `new EmergencyOracle(address(0), description)` so the emitted event and returned contract address differ on the owner field.
Replaced emit `NewEmergencyOracle(msg.sender, newOracle)` with `emit NewEmergencyOracle(address(0), newOracle)` to change the logged owner in the event.
Removed the onlyAdmin modifier so anyone can call newEmergencyOracle, changing which newEmergencyOracle addresses get created and emitted.
